Partner Program changes payout tiers for mid-size channels

The Partner Program will move mid-size channels to a new payout tier in October, changing the revenue share on short-form advertising from 45 to 50 percent for channels above one hundred thousand subscribers.

Channels below that threshold keep the current terms, and the platform says the change follows a nine-month pilot across three markets.
